feeds.title: A Muslim Homeschool
feeds.description: A Muslim Homeschool blog started as the documentation of personal experiences from a home educator 3 years ago. It evolved into a means to share educational resources and articles relating to the Muslim child, education and family life.

feeds.title: Umm Maimoonah's Journal
feeds.description: Assalaamu Alaikum! I am a Muslimah trying to please Allaah and continuing the journey of educating my daughter with the correct tasfiyah(purification) and tarrbiyah (cultivation)upon the Qur'aan and the Sunnah as understood by the Salafus Saalih (pious predecessors). Get the latest updates at Umm Maimoonah's Journal blog.

feeds.title: Our Muslim Homeschool Blog
feeds.description: Assalamu alaikum and welcome to Our Muslim Homeschool! We offer support and resources that make homeschooling our Muslim children rewarding and beneficial. Follow this blog for homeschooling resources, product and curriculum reviews, advice about home-education and day-in-the-life videos.

feeds.title: Muslim Homeschoolers Unite Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Eaman Elhadri, My desire is to provide you with encouragement, inspiration, practical help, and beautiful Islamic resources for your daily homeschooling life as a Muslim mom. We are Muslim homeschooling mothers, walking hand-in-hand in this beautiful journey.

feeds.title: Rahmah Muslim Homeschool
feeds.description: Rahmah Muslim Homeschool is dedicated to Muslim parents who homeschool or are considering to homeschool their children. Its mission is to educate children according to the Qur'an and the Sunnah.

feeds.title: Ihsaan Home Academy
feeds.description: A Muslim homeschooling and parenting blog. You can find free printables, educational resources, parenting tips, and more.

feeds.title: Salam Homeschooling
feeds.description: Assalamo alaykum and welcome. I am a Muslim homeschooling mum of 3, trying to cultivate myself and my children upon the Qur'an and the Sunnah, according to the understanding of the companions. Reaching out to share resources and reflections with you.

feeds.title: everydayibaadah Blog
feeds.description: We are committed to creating resources made especially for the Muslim student - that are common core compatible, meets national and next generation science standards for learning. We are creating materials Muslim children can see themselves reflected in, and which can relate to their everyday lives and experiences.
